{{Top|leg}}
'''Star Tours Flight 1106''' was the designation of a [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency flight to [[Ord Cantrell/Legends|Ord Cantrell]] and [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] just before a [[Raid at Spaceport THX1138|raid at the Star Tours space station]]. Stationed at Gate 1K, the flight's scheduled arrival at the [[Spaceport THX1138|space station]] at 1115 hours was delayed, moving the scheduled departure time from 1210 to 1300 hours.
